picks.title: India's Airbound bags $37M to take on trucks with rocket-like drones
picks.why_it_matters: A $37M round led by Greenoaks with strategic backing from DoorDash signals growing conviction in drone logistics as a viable last-mile alternative, opening co-investment or follow-on opportunities in the autonomous delivery stack.

picks.title: US nutrition startup Berry Street merges with India's Healthify as GLP-1 trends upwards
picks.why_it_matters: This cross-border merger validates the massive emerging market around GLP-1 companion services, signaling deal flow opportunities in nutrition, behavioral health, and metabolic wellness startups riding the Ozempic wave.

picks.title: How Europe is killing makers and micro-entrepreneurs
picks.why_it_matters: Regulatory burdens pushing hardware makers out of Europe could create arbitrage opportunities for US-based startups and platforms serving indie hardware founders, while signaling caution for EU-focused portfolio companies.
